title: On the maximum relational complexity of affine groups
summary: Let $G$ be a group of permutations of a set $Ω$. The relational complexity $\mathrm{RC}(G)$ is the least integer $r\geq 2$ such that the $G$-orbit of every finite tuple is determined by the $G$-orbits of its $r$-subtuples; there is currently only a small collection of groups $G$ for which $\mathrm{RC}(G)$ is known precisely. In this paper we study the relational complexity of finite affine groups acting naturally on a $d$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_q$.
